title: Skull Wizard Cat Concert
description: A giant green skull wearing red sunglasses sits on a snowy wooden stage with its mouth open, revealing colorful objects inside. A skeletal cat wizard in ornate robes and glasses floats above, holding a glowing turquoise staff amid swirling purple magic and ghostly figures, while two skeleton musicians play saxophone and drums at the base.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene inside a wooden barn with a snowy stage. A giant green skull wearing red sunglasses sits with its mouth open, colorful objects inside. Two skeleton musicians in cloaks play a golden saxophone and a drum set. Above them floats a large anthropomorphic cat wizard with pink ears and glasses, wearing ornate blue and gold robes with a red cape, holding a glowing turquoise magical staff. Swirling purple energy, ghosts, lightning, and pine trees in the background under a dramatic twilight sky.
